title: Lonnie Zamora never the same after Socorro

tellings.quote: you know, Sakor, New Mexico. I remember the wife of Lonnie Zamora looking at me and she goes, "I don't know what happened when he looked at that creature, but he was never the same."

plain: James Fox, a guest on a podcast, recalls speaking with the wife of Lonnie Zamora, a man who reported an encounter near Socorro, New Mexico, in 1964. Fox says she told him, "I don't know what happened when he looked at that creature, but he was never the same." In this telling the encounter left a lasting mark on the man who saw it.
